acceptance: Read-only Doctor and Audit run from the original project root before writes; existing warnings remain visible.
The product roadmap maps every advertised capability to implementation ownership, executable acceptance and realistic later service activation boundaries.
The original project root remains non-Git and all existing files, receipts, snapshots, Ledger and unrelated modifications are retained.
A new offline integration repository contains an explicitly inventoried copy of local source evidence with no remotes.
Three actual Git worktrees are created from the same immutable seed commit, with disjoint source ownership and gpt-5.6-luna high execution tasks.
Worker delivery requires focused tests, source-bound change inventory, no-op and failure recovery checks and independent integration review; mocks do not count as live service or host validation.
inputs.metric: Twelve named product acceptance milestones, exact module ownership, versioned integration contracts, SHA256 seed inventory and three started worktree tasks. No milestone is accepted based on task completion messages alone.
non_goals: Do not modify original scripts, tests, README, root AGENTS, historical artifacts, receipts, snapshots or Ledger.
Do not push, publish, release, provision external services, access credentials or production data, spend money on infrastructure, or execute downstream products.
Do not pretend the entire product is delivered when only architecture and implementation dispatch are complete.
inputs.outcome: Establish an evidence-bound product architecture, acceptance roadmap and three isolated local Git worktrees, then dispatch foundation implementation tasks using gpt-5.6-luna high. Existing repository fixtures remain untouched.
inputs.problem: The advertised beginner journey is not implemented; current scripts return offline simulation output and lack a real product entry point, semantic intake, specific plans, safe document application and actual task execution.
inputs.rollback: The original source files are not changed. Stop worker tasks before any cleanup; keep the new plan record, receipt, inventory, worktree commits and recovery evidence. Abandon the isolated branches without applying them to the original root. Any later cleanup must separately verify exact absolute paths and must not remove historical evidence.
inputs.rollout: Preview this transaction, inspect scope and controller result, apply only the new plan record and receipt, create product documents and a seed inventory, initialize a new isolated local repository, create three worktrees, dispatch named Luna high tasks, inspect their startup statuses and record task IDs. Integration back to the original product files requires a subsequent exact-path transaction.
